edits.reason: Merges diagnosis_001 and diagnosis_014: same retail pending-order mutation ordering mechanism, same one-time item lock trigger, same repair operator (non-locking whole-order payment/address modifications before item modification, item modification last), and same stopping boundary after 'pending (item modified)'; one rule preserves payment-only and payment-plus-address variants.
edits.text: For retail requests, when a confirmed multi-change request on a single pending order includes modify_pending_order_items together with modify_pending_order_address or modify_pending_order_payment, complete and verify the requested whole-order payment or shipping-address modifications first, then execute modify_pending_order_items last in one collected call; verify the final order state and report all requested changes as completed. Once modify_pending_order_items returns status 'pending (item modified)', make no further modify_pending_order_address or modify_pending_order_payment calls for that order.

verification_target.expected_behavior: Agent completes and verifies the requested whole-order payment or shipping-address modifications first, then executes modify_pending_order_items last in one collected call, verifies the final order state, and makes no further address or payment modification calls after item modification returns 'pending (item modified)'.
verification_target.problem: Agent executes the one-time pending-order item modification before non-locking whole-order payment or address modifications, locking the order and causing the later payment modification to fail.
verification_target.trigger_condition: A confirmed multi-change request on a single pending order includes modify_pending_order_items together with modify_pending_order_address or modify_pending_order_payment.

edits.reason: Adds the missing pre-execution reminder mechanism for one-time pending-order item modification; source diagnoses share trigger, repair operator, and stopping boundary.
edits.text: For retail requests, before calling modify_pending_order_items, present the exact items to modify, price consequence, payment method, and unchanged state, and explicitly remind the customer to confirm that all items to be modified have been provided; wait for explicit confirmation before executing the one-time item modification.

verification_target.expected_behavior: Agent presents the complete modification details, explicitly reminds the customer to confirm that all items to modify have been provided, waits for explicit confirmation, and only then calls modify_pending_order_items.
verification_target.problem: Agent omits the required all-items-provided reminder before executing a pending-order item modification.
verification_target.trigger_condition: Agent is about to confirm and execute a pending-order item modification using modify_pending_order_items.

edits.reason: Adds the supported-facts-only stopping boundary for refund-timing questions; preserves the source prohibition on invented quantified timelines.
edits.text: For retail requests, when asked about credit-card refund timing after a delivered-order return, state only facts supported by the policy, tool outputs, and user inputs; do not invent or carry over a quantified refund timeline. If the specific credit-card refund timing is not provided, state that it is not available.

verification_target.expected_behavior: Agent states only supported return/refund facts, states that the refund goes to the original credit card, and states that specific credit-card refund timing is not available.
verification_target.problem: Agent asserts an unsupported credit-card refund timing after a delivered-order return, such as '5-7 business days'.
verification_target.trigger_condition: User asks how long a refund will take after a delivered-order return request.

edits.reason: Adds authority-state refresh requirement after balance-changing actions; preserves trigger, decision boundary, and stopping boundary from the source diagnosis.
edits.text: For retail requests, after any balance-changing action in the same conversation, such as a cancellation refund, and before denying a gift-card-funded pending-order payment modification or transferring, re-read current user/payment-method data and recompute the available gift card balance against the order total. If the updated balance is sufficient, explain the modification details, obtain explicit confirmation, and call modify_pending_order_payment. If it is still insufficient, deny that method and offer only permitted alternatives.

verification_target.expected_behavior: Agent re-reads current user/payment-method data, recomputes the gift card balance against the order total; if sufficient, explains details, obtains explicit confirmation, and calls modify_pending_order_payment; if insufficient, denies that method and offers only permitted alternatives.
verification_target.problem: Agent relies on stale pre-action gift card balance after a balance-changing action, causing it to refuse a feasible payment-method modification or escalate unnecessarily.
verification_target.trigger_condition: A balance-sensitive decision about a gift-card-funded pending-order payment modification occurs after an earlier action may have changed that gift card balance.

edits.reason: Adds incremental-charge comparison for conditional package changes; preserves the source threshold, branch selection order, and confirmation boundary.
edits.text: For airline requests, when a conditional cabin-plus-baggage change is authorized only if the package total is at most a stated limit and the reservation has an existing prior paid amount, compute each candidate package as its new package total minus the already paid reservation amount, and compare that incremental charge to the limit. Select Business if its incremental charge is at most the limit; otherwise select Economy if its incremental charge is at most the limit; otherwise make no mutation. Do not apply passenger, cabin, or baggage writes until the correct branch is selected and the user explicitly confirms the complete proposal.

verification_target.expected_behavior: Agent computes each candidate package as new package total minus already paid amount, compares the incremental charge to the threshold, selects Business if eligible else Economy if eligible else makes no mutation, obtains explicit confirmation before writes, and applies no mutation if none eligible.
verification_target.problem: Agent evaluates the conditional package threshold using the gross new package total instead of the incremental charge after subtracting the already paid amount.
verification_target.trigger_condition: A conditional cabin-plus-baggage change depends on package total being at most a stated limit and the reservation has an existing prior paid amount.

edits.reason: Adds single-use payment-method allocation preservation; source trigger, post-use availability decision boundary, and confirmation boundary are preserved.
edits.text: For airline requests, when multiple bookings must be paid with a limited set of user-authorized payment methods that includes a travel certificate that becomes unavailable after use, do not allocate the certificate to an earlier booking if it is needed for a later booking. Propose, obtain confirmation for, and execute an allocation that completes all bookings sequentially using only currently available user-authorized payment methods; for example, use a gift card for the earlier lower-cost booking and reserve the certificate for the later booking it must cover. Stop before any booking call with a payment method that is not currently available; if no allocation can complete all bookings within the approved methods, explain the constraint or transfer as appropriate.

verification_target.expected_behavior: Agent proposes and confirms an allocation using the gift card for the earlier lower-cost booking and reserves the certificate for the later booking it must cover; all bookings complete using only currently available authorized methods without reuse.
verification_target.problem: Agent uses the travel certificate on the first cheaper booking and then attempts to reuse it for the later booking, leaving no authorized payment method for the later booking.
verification_target.trigger_condition: Multiple bookings use a limited authorized payment method set that includes a single-use travel certificate, and the certificate is needed for a later booking while another method can cover the earlier booking.

edits.reason: Adds highest-fare allocation for single-use certificates across multiple bookings; preserves source trigger, allocation priority, confirmation boundary, and stopping boundary.
edits.text: For airline requests, when multiple bookings are paid with a single-use travel certificate and one or more divisible gift cards, allocate the travel certificate to only one booking and prioritize the booking with the highest fare that does not exceed the certificate balance; use the gift card for lower-fare bookings. Confirm the payment plan with the user before executing. If the certificate cannot cover any single booking or remaining gift card balances cannot cover the other bookings, stop and ask for alternative payment methods.

verification_target.expected_behavior: Agent proposes and confirms an allocation using the gift card for the lower-cost booking and the certificate for the highest-cost booking it can cover; if no allocation completes all bookings within available methods, agent stops and asks for alternatives.
verification_target.problem: Agent allocates a single-use travel certificate to an earlier lower-cost booking, leaving it unavailable for a later higher-cost booking and causing booking failure.
verification_target.trigger_condition: User requests multiple bookings and specifies a travel certificate and gift card where the certificate is consumed on first use and total booking cost exceeds the gift card balance.

edits.reason: Adds original kept-segment price preservation for conditional partial flight changes; preserves source calculation operator and pre-update stopping boundary.
edits.text: For airline requests, when a conditional partial flight change keeps one or more segments unchanged, compute the new reservation total using the original reserved price for each kept segment and the candidate current price only for the changed segment. Compare that total to the original reservation total to establish the correct branch and exact payment or refund consequence before selecting a candidate or calling update_reservation_flights; obtain explicit user confirmation before executing the update.

verification_target.expected_behavior: Agent computes the new total with original reserved prices for kept segments and current candidate price for the changed segment; compares to the original total; presents the correct branch and exact consequence; obtains explicit confirmation; then calls update_reservation_flights.
verification_target.problem: Agent uses the current searched price of an unchanged kept segment instead of its original reservation price, causing wrong branch selection and an update attempt before the kept-segment pricing rule is validated.
verification_target.trigger_condition: A conditional partial flight change keeps one segment unchanged and the decision depends on the additional payment or refund required.

edits.reason: Adds per-passenger fare-difference calculation for cabin changes; preserves source baseline, reconciliation, and confirmation boundaries.
edits.text: For airline requests, before requesting confirmation for a cabin-class change whose fare difference must be listed, compute the difference from the original per-passenger fare stored on the reservation and the current per-passenger fare for the new cabin multiplied by passenger count; do not use total payment_history as the baseline. State the exact expected charge in the complete proposal, obtain explicit confirmation, and ensure the confirmed amount matches the subsequent tool result before proceeding.

verification_target.expected_behavior: Agent computes the charge from original and new per-passenger fares multiplied by passenger count, discloses the exact charge, obtains explicit confirmation, and reconciles the confirmed amount with the tool result before proceeding.
verification_target.problem: Agent computes cabin-change fare difference using total payment_history rather than original per-passenger fare total, understating the charge before confirmation.
verification_target.trigger_condition: Agent is preparing a complete pre-confirmation proposal for a cabin-class change with a fare difference.

edits.reason: Merges diagnosis_028 and diagnosis_029: same already-flown cancellation mechanism, same trigger, same repair operator (mandatory transfer to human agents), and same stopping boundary; one rule preserves both recurrence variants.
edits.text: For airline requests, before soliciting cancellation confirmation or calling cancel_reservation, check whether any portion of the reservation has already been flown. If any flight has already been flown, do not rely on cabin class or other cancellation eligibility; inform the user that the cancellation cannot be handled because part of the trip has already been flown, call transfer_to_human_agents, and send the required transfer message. Do not call cancel_reservation.

verification_target.expected_behavior: Agent informs the user that cancellation cannot be handled because part of the trip has already been flown, calls transfer_to_human_agents, sends the required transfer message, and does not call cancel_reservation.
verification_target.problem: Agent treats business class as sufficient for cancellation even when part of the reservation has already been flown.
verification_target.trigger_condition: User requests cancellation and user statement or reservation details show that any flight segment has already been flown.

edits.reason: Merges diagnosis_030 and diagnosis_031: same travel-insurance cancellation-eligibility mechanism, same trigger, same repair operator (verify covered reason before cancellation), and same stopping boundary; one rule preserves both source branches.
edits.text: For airline requests, before presenting a cancellation as eligible, requesting confirmation, or calling cancel_reservation, verify that at least one full permitted cancellation condition is satisfied: booking within the last 24 hours, airline cancellation, business-class flight, or travel insurance with a covered health or weather reason. Travel insurance alone is not sufficient for a change-of-plan or other non-covered reason. If no condition is met, explain that cancellation is not permitted, stop, and do not call cancel_reservation or state that a refund will be issued.

verification_target.expected_behavior: Agent verifies the cancellation criteria, determines travel insurance with a non-covered reason does not qualify, declines cancellation, and does not call cancel_reservation or state that a refund will be issued.
verification_target.problem: Agent treats travel insurance alone as sufficient for cancellation when the reason is change of plans and no other permitted cancellation condition is met.
verification_target.trigger_condition: Cancellation request with insurance present, non-health or non-weather reason, and no booking-within-24-hours, airline-cancellation, or business-class condition.

edits.reason: Merges diagnosis_032, diagnosis_033, and diagnosis_034: same flight-modification route-preservation mechanism, same trigger/decision boundary, same repair operator (refuse origin/destination/trip-type changes), and same pre-update stopping boundary; one rule preserves all route-change variants.
edits.text: For airline requests, before searching for, confirming, or executing a flight modification with update_reservation_flights, compare the existing reservation's origin, destination, and trip type with each proposed replacement flight. If any proposed flight would change origin, destination, or trip type, stop and explain that flight modifications cannot change origin, destination, or trip type; do not call update_reservation_flights. When selecting among candidates, include only same-origin, same-destination, same-trip-type options.

verification_target.expected_behavior: Agent refuses the route-changing modification, explains that flight modifications cannot change origin, destination, or trip type, and does not call update_reservation_flights.
verification_target.problem: Agent modifies a reservation to a replacement flight with a different origin, destination, or trip type despite the policy prohibition.
verification_target.trigger_condition: User requests a flight modification and a proposed replacement flight differs from the existing reservation in origin, destination, or trip type.
